import datetime,difflib,hashlib,json,pathlib
B=pathlib.Path('/workspace/scratch/actual-source-regular-local-collar-construct');S=pathlib.Path('/workspace/Math-curvature-20261026/frontiers/source_derivative_gaussian_20261025/SourceActualRegularLocalCollar.lean')
old=S.read_text();a="  rw [heq, hd.fderiv]";assert old.count(a)==1;new=old.replace(a,"  have hactual : HasFDerivAt (I4LifetimeField.actualField 2 2 fixtureSample)\n      (-Real.sin (Real.pi * (Q Y) 0) • Real.pi • d0 +\n        (2 : ℝ) • -Real.sin (Real.pi * (Q Y) 1) • Real.pi • d1) Y := by\n    rw [heq]\n    exact hd\n  rw [hactual.fderiv]")
H=B/'history/production-fixtures-fix002';H.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False);orig=H/'SourceActualRegularLocalCollar.lean.ORIGINAL';orig.write_text(old);S.write_text(new)
p=B/'PRODUCTION_FIXTURES_FIX002_FULL.patch';p.write_text(''.join(difflib.unified_diff(old.splitlines(keepends=True),new.splitlines(keepends=True),fromfile='history/production-fixtures-fix002/SourceActualRegularLocalCollar.lean.ORIGINAL',tofile='SourceActualRegularLocalCollar.lean')))
cp=B/'FIRST_ID_CACHE.json';cache=json.loads(cp.read_text());prior=cache[str(S)];st=orig.stat();cache[str(orig)]={**prior,'path':str(orig),'marker':[st.st_size,st.st_mtime_ns],'origin':'Known exact prior source ID REUSED; no hash','copied_from':str(S)}
st=p.stat();cache[str(p)]={'path':str(p),'bytes':st.st_size,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'marker':[st.st_size,st.st_mtime_ns],'first_observed_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'origin':'FIRST new actual full patch identity, once'};cp.write_text(json.dumps(cache,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'scope':'Only fixtures002 pointwise function-add derivative rewrite shape','full_patch':str(p)}))
